system_prompt_style.note: Paper does not describe system prompt construction; Planner uses few high-level demonstrations.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the agent must actively explore the environment to gather critical information about both the task and the functionality of the web elements
env_context_strategy.note: Web environment; observation is the current page actree.

observation_format.evidence_quote: WebPilot operates as a text-only agent, leveraging the accessibility tree, i.e., actree, of the webpage without relying on visual observations

tool_call_format.note: Actions like "click link 'Members'" shown but parsing syntax not described.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: WebPilot operates as a text-only agent, leveraging the accessibility tree, i.e., actree, of the webpage
edit_primitive.note: Web agent; no file-editing tool described. Absence inferred from paper only.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the Local Optimization phase executes each subtask using a tailored MCTS designed for complex environments
loop_primitives.note: Global Optimization: Planner generates plan then subtasks executed (Algo. 1); Controller re-executes incomplete subtasks with reflection.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Hierarchical Task Decomposition (HTD) begins with Planner breaking down complex tasks into smaller, manageable subtasksTi
planning_granularity.note: Plan P of subtasks with subtask objectives, refined via RTA; subtasks handled by distinct agent roles.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the Global Optimization phase is driven by Planner, Controller, and Extractor
multi_agent_topology.note: Multi-agent roles (Planner, Controller, Extractor, Explorer, Verifier, Appraiser); likely LLM role prompts within one system. Closest value; could be pipeline/hierarchical.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Explorer, Verifier, and Appraiser work together to complete the task
delegation_mechanism.note: Mechanism not specified; roles appear to pass control within a single process.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Controller assesses the completeness of the subtask T1, generates subtask reflection Rsub if needed and updates the current planP
short_term_state.note: Plan, MCTS tree with Q-values, reflections maintained.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Appraiser evaluates both the effective-ness of the executed action at and the potential of the result-ing observation ot+1
self_verification.note: Appraiser 0-10 scoring, Controller completeness check, Verifier, reflections; same LLM with role prompts.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If the completeness assessment indicates that the subtask is not complete, Con-troller initiates a re-execution of the subtask.

rollback.note: MCTS selects nodes but how environment state is restored is not described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: we limit the max node count per subtask to 10
termination_condition.note: Controller decides subtask completion; run ends when plan P is empty.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: We utilize GPT-3.5 and GPT-4o 1, each configured with a max tokens limit of 4096 tokens
cost_controls.note: Per-call max output tokens only; weak fit for a per-run budget. Quote spans a line break in the source.

permission_model.note: Verifier checks action validity/non-redundancy, not authorisation.

eval_hooks.note: Evaluated on WebArena and MiniWoB++; no repo evidence of built-in hooks.
